verdict.rationale: Weaviate's docs describe running as a multi-node cluster with data replicated across nodes. They also say each tenant is stored on its own shard, and Kubernetes is listed as a deployment option, so distributed deployment beyond one node is documented. missing for 10: explicit docs on horizontal sharding of a collection across nodes for capacity scaling, guidance on adding nodes or rebalancing, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-node scaling.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can scale beyond one node with sharding or distributed deployment

citations.quote: Weaviate allows data replication across a multi-node cluster by setting a replication factor > 1.
Each tenant is stored on a separate shard.
Weaviate offers multiple installation and deployment options: Docker, Kubernetes, Weaviate Cloud
